title: 异形接点
reference_delivery: 文字首生；所列第三方参考只由助手观看，未显式传入。
semantic_affordances: 不同事物的联系、对话或匹配；两个形体不可自动视为人物。
origin: 本项目原创生成素材；非第三方裁切或原站原图。

self_evaluation.evidence: 异形接点和曲线连接清楚；不同部件线重存在差异，只在需要联系语义时选用。

actual_tool_arguments.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset: one original reusable non-character geometric illustration motif, not a sprite sheet.
Drawing construction: clean two-dimensional digital line-and-fill. Use a continuous medium electric-blue contour (#1844F5), a small bright turquoise / sky-blue / pink palette and white only where specified. Every bounded plane has one even solid color; keep volume implicit in the overlap or fold edges. Keep detail sparse and the silhouette distinct. These are uninhabited shapes and lines, with no human features.
Motif: One small sky-blue rounded triangle on the left and one pink circular disk on the right, separated by breathing space and joined by one loose electric-blue curved line. Let the line visibly touch each shape at one boundary point. Use plain geometric fills, unequal sizes and slightly asymmetric placement. No eyes, mouths or limbs.
Delivery: a single centered isolated motif, requested 1024×1024 PNG with genuinely transparent alpha around it, filling about the middle two-thirds of the canvas while preserving clean outer padding. Draw no label, text, border, contact sheet, scene, platform, shadow, surface gradient or glow. This one motif will later be combined with other independently saved motifs.

record_normalization: 原始工具提示词不变；本机绝对输入路径仅替换为仓库内对应文件路径，避免发布机器路径。
